title: Understanding the Expression
text: Let's break down the expression $$\left(y_i-\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {\theta}^t\right)\right) X_i$$. Consider the dimensions of each component: $$X_i$$ is a row vector from the design matrix X, and $${\theta}^t$$ is a vector of model weights. What happens when you multiply these two?

title: Exploring the Sigma Function
text: The function $$\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {\theta}^t\right)$$ is a scalar because it represents the logistic function applied to a single value. How does this affect the dimensions of the expression when subtracted from $$y_i$$?

title: Determining the Dimensions
text: Given that $$y_i-\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {\theta}^t\right)$$ is a scalar, what are the dimensions of the product $$\left(y_i-\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {\theta}^t\right)\right) X_i$$?
